readings: For each invoice number in Invoice_Line_Items, compute the average product_quantity (cast to a number, ignoring NULLs). Compute the relative gap as (SUM(derived_product_cost) − SUM(derived_total_cost)) ÷ SUM(derived_total_cost) over that invoice's line items, so it is a ratio of sums. Compute the overall average as the mean of the per-invoice average quantities. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is strictly above that overall average. Return invoice number, average quantity, relative gap, and average quantity minus the overall average. Sort by that difference descending with NULLs last, return the top 10, and don't round.

For each invoice number in Invoice_Line_Items, compute the average product_quantity (cast to a number, ignoring NULLs). Compute the relative gap as the average, over that invoice's line items, of the per-line ratio (derived_product_cost − derived_total_cost) ÷ derived_total_cost, ignoring lines where the ratio is NULL. Compute the overall average as the mean of the per-invoice average quantities. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is strictly above that overall average. Return invoice number, average quantity, relative gap, and average quantity minus the overall average. Sort by that difference descending with NULLs last, return the top 10, and don't round.
queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty,
         (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_total_cost) AS relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT invoice_number,
       avg_qty AS average_quantity,
       relative_gap,
       avg_qty - (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) FROM inv) AS diff_from_overall_average
FROM inv
WHERE avg_qty > (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) FROM inv)
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty,
         AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM inv
)
SELECT inv.invoice_number,
       inv.avg_qty AS average_quantity,
       inv.relative_gap,
       inv.avg_qty - overall.overall_avg AS diff
FROM inv, overall
WHERE inv.avg_qty > overall.overall_avg
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
